get.description: Version 2: hard eligibility, discovery/cooldown tiers, then normalized weighted ranking. Actual visible impressions are separate from delivery/preload; exact liked/saved items receive a longer repeat cooldown. Cooldowns relax after better candidates are exhausted. Continuous discovery in cycles. Cycle 1 serves Reels the viewer has not meaningfully watched; when it is exhausted the next cycle starts automatically with every eligible Reel in a new, relevance-weighted shuffled order (never opening with the Reel just shown). A Reel appears at most once per cycle; use `entries[].key` as queue identity. Bounded PostgreSQL ranking, 48-hour sessions, signed keyset cursors, creator diversity. `hasMore` is false only when nothing eligible remains (0 Reels, or a single Reel that simply loops). info.title: Community Platform Social API
info.description:
REST API for the social platform. All paths are relative to the server root and include the global prefix.

**Auth:** send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Obtain tokens from `/auth/register`, `/auth/login`, rotate with `/auth/refresh`.
**Pagination:** cursor based — `{ items, nextCursor, hasMore }`; pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`.
**Errors:** `{ statusCode, code, message, details[] }` — branch on `code`.
**Timestamps:** ISO 8601 UTC.

maintenanceMessage.description: Show as a banner when not empty

received.description: Bytes received so far — send the next piece from this offset

chunkSize.description: Suggested piece size in bytes (max 16 MB)

url.description: Signed, expiring URL. Do not persist; refetch the parent resource for a fresh URL.
